selection.sampling: all eligible records; no result-dependent subsampling

rights_review.basis: NCBI molecular-data usage policy; ClinVar requests source attribution. No blanket transfer of submitter rights or MIT relicensing is asserted.
rights_review.attribution: ClinVar, National Center for Biotechnology Information; snapshot 2026-09-03; cite ClinVar in publications.
rights_review.transformations: Select minimal structured variant records; construct artificial diploid SNP inputs and rule-derived expectations. No submitted narratives, patient records or participant genomes are used.
rights_review.redistribution: Retrieve the exact source by checksum. The complete source is not added to Git. Review any proposed release of derived records separately.
